notes:
- New: best-of-three Ranked queues.
- New: Timeless (All Cards) in friend challenges: play any decks against each other.
- New: battles can be attacked, and revealed top cards (Oracle of Mul Daya, Lantern of Insight) show face up.
- New: divide damage or counters among targets (Fury, Pyrokinesis, The Earth Crystal).
- New: you pick the creature to tap for Station, Crew and costs like Relic of Legends; Station charge shows as a badge.
- Fix: cost reductions (Goblin Anarchomancer) and mana Auras (Utopia Sprawl, Wild Growth) count for auto-tap and the Pay button; Reflecting Pool can be tapped by hand.
- Fix: flavor text on cards without rules text, loyalty badges, Fuse and Aftermath cards.
- Fix: a friend challenge between different versions of MTG Arena or MTGA Forge now says so in the game, with what to update, instead of hanging after the countdown.
- Fix: missing text on buttons and menus on some installs (mostly Steam).
- Fix: the launcher no longer closes without a word: it explains when it was opened from inside the zip or from a shared folder (Parallels), and saves any error to a log.
